name: A10-0189/2025 – David Cormand – Motion for a resolution
title: REPORT on a new legislative framework for products that is fit for the digital and sustainable transition
part_text:
The European Parliament is asking the European Commission to update the EU's main rulebook for selling products. The current rules date from 2008 and do not cover digital products, sustainability or online shopping well. The Parliament wants a digital product passport so people can check a product's origin, durability and recyclability. It also wants clearer rules for repairers and second-hand sellers, and stronger checks on products sold online from outside the EU. This is an opinion; no law changes yet.

- The Commission is asked to propose a revised product rulebook, including a digital product passport.
- It affects manufacturers, repairers, second-hand sellers, online platforms and shoppers.
- Next, the Commission decides whether to draft a formal legal proposal.
